Inglewood, California
  March 24, 2020

The Successor Agency of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
Tuesday, March 24, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

Mayor Butts called the City Council into joint session with the Successor
Agency/Parking Authority for Closed Session at the hour of 1:01 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Parking Authority Secretary announced the
presence of a quorum as follows:
  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Parking Authority
  Chairman Butts, Council Members/Successor Agency
  Members/Parking Authority Members Padilla, Morales and
  Franklin; and
  Absent:  Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Parking
  Authority Member Dotson.
City/Successor Agency/Parking Authority officials and personnel present for closed
session were as follows:

  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

Serves as Indicated for the Successor Agency, and Parking Authority

PUBLIC  COMMENTS  REGARDING  CLOSED  SESSION  ITEMS.
Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Parking Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there
were any persons present who wished to address the City Council/Successor
Agency/Parking Authority on the Closed Session Items.

There was no response.

Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Parking Authority Chairman Butts recessed the City
Council/Successor Agency/Parking Authority at the hour of 1:01 p.m. for Closed Session
Item Nos. CS-1, CSA-5 & P-2, and CS-2, CSA-6 & P-3.

  *****************
Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Parking
Authority, and Joint Powers Authority at the hour of 2:03 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/Parking
Authority Secretary/Joint Powers Authority Secretary announced the presence of a
quorum as follows:
  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman/Parking Authority Chairman/Joint Powers
  Authority Chairman Butts, Council Members/Successor
  Agency Members/Housing Authority Members/Parking
  Authority Members/Joint Powers Authority Members
  Padilla, Morales, and Franklin; and
  Absent:  Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing
  Authority Member/Parking Authority Member/Joint
  Power Authority Member Dotson.

 125  AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO AGREEMENT NO. 20-020 APPROVED – KANE
  BALLMER & BERKMAN; RESOLUTION NO. 20-57 ADOPTED – AMENDING
  THE FISCAL YEAR 2019-2020 ANNUAL BUDGET. Staff report dated March 24,
  2020, was presented recommending approval of Amendment No. 1 to Agreement No. 20-
  020 with Kane, Ballmer & Berkman to provide legal services on behalf of the City,
  Successor Agency, Housing Authority and Parking Authority.

  It was moved by Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority
  Member/Parking Authority Member Morales, and seconded by Council
  Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member/Parking Authority
  Member Franklin that the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Parking
  Authority does hereby approve Amendment No. 1 to Agreement No. 20-020 in the
  amount of $250,000. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council  Members/Successor  Agency  Members/Housing  Authority
  Members/Parking Authority Members Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor
  Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council  Member/Successor  Agency  Member/Housing  Authority
  Member/Parking Authority Member Dotson.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Franklin
  that Resolution No. 20-57 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE 2019-2020 ANNUAL
  BUDGET TO RECEIVE FUNDS TO ENGAGE SPECIAL COUNSEL FOR
  VARIOUS LEGAL SERVICES

  be adopted. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Dotson.

 142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Mayor /Successor
  Agency Chairman / Housing Authority Chairman Butts, and seconded by Council
  Member /Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Franklin that the
  demands presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated
  March 19, 2020, in the amount of $1,639,780.03, are hereby allowed, and the City
  Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to
  certify upon said registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
